body.intent: Fix The daemon never reaps its finished run drivers: 50 zombie 'rhiza' processes, all children of the daemon (pid 1348, up 30 h), the oldest 30 h old; the owner saw '50 zombie processes' at ssh login on 2026-11-06. The daemon starts each run's driver (run start/resume --foreground) and never waits on it; it also re-execs itself in place on a new binary (same pid), after which it cannot know the children it had before. Reap with a periodic non-blocking wait for any child (wait4(-1, WNOHANG) in a loop, which also covers children from before a re-exec), and add a test that a finished child of the daemon leaves no zombie.
